highestAppliedCap.reason: High-impact local agent and privacy claims are not fully evidence-backed on the daemon production path and deployment-state Firestore App Check path.

categoryScores.mainReason: Strong component inventory and existing threat-model docs; this audit adds stateful registers.
Several claims are evidence-backed, but Computer Use and Signal/E2EE wording must be narrowed.
Generated endpoint matrix, owner checks, high-risk nonces, App Check, passkeys, and Firestore rules are strong.
AES-GCM AAD, Keychain, Ed25519 MCP tokens, and webhook HMAC exist; daemon proof and Signal claim gaps remain.
Shared validators and storage bounds exist; Stripe URL helper and public endpoint rate-limit coverage need fixes.
Functions config fails closed for App Check, but Firestore App Check and some edge controls require deployment verification.
Logging scrubbers, privacy invariants, export sanitizer, and deletion exist; deletion audit is not fail closed.
Pinned actions, CodeQL, gitleaks, dependency review, OSV, provenance, and policy gates exist; deploy fallback secrets remain.
Many security tests exist, but the production daemon proof wiring and deployment-state checks are missing.
Computer Use has gates, approvals, audit, and panic paths; daemon production wiring weakens high-impact claims.
This package provides the missing audit artifacts; remaining evidence gaps block full external audit.
